subject: general
question: In March 2025, Indian PM Narendra Modi attended the National Day celebrations of which country as the Chief Guest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mauritius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the National Day celebrations of **Mauritius** as the Chief Guest in March 2025.
 
• Mauritius celebrates its National Day on **March 12** every year, marking its independence from British rule in 1968 and its transformation into a Republic in 1992.
 
• PM Modi’s visit highlights the deep-rooted ties between India and Mauritius, which share cultural, historical, and strategic connections.
 
• India has been a key development partner of Mauritius, providing financial and technological assistance in areas like infrastructure, defense, and capacity building.
 
• The visit underscores India’s commitment to its "neighborhood first" and "SAGAR" (Security and Growth for All in the Region) initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Mauritius Relations:**

 
 
• Mauritius hosts a significant population of Indian origin, strengthening cultural and people-to-people ties.
 
• India has supported Mauritius in various sectors, including education, healthcare, and technology.
 
• Key projects like the Metro Express and Supreme Court building in Mauritius were funded by India.
 
 
 
• **SAGAR Initiative:**
 
 
• SAGAR stands for "Security and Growth for All in the Region," an Indian maritime initiative aimed at enhancing security and economic cooperation in the Indian Ocean.
 
• Mauritius is a critical partner under this initiative due to its strategic location in the Indian Ocean.
 
 
 
• **National Day of Mauritius:**
 
 
• The National Day celebrations include parades, cultural events, and speeches commemorating the nation’s achievements.
 
• March 12 is significant as it marks the day of independence and the adoption of the Republican constitution.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• Indo-Mauritian ties date back to the migration of Indian laborers during colonial times, establishing a strong historical bond.
 
• The two countries share a common history of colonial struggles and post-independence development.
